content.study:
Section 43F — Resignation of Members

Section 43F governs resignation of Members of the Arbitration Council of India and the statutory procedure and consequences associated with leaving office.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework. Its operative use depends on the current text, commencement status and regulations made under the Act.
